hero.title: Your customers forget.
hero.titleAccent: Gearva remembers and brings them back.
hero.lead: The simple system for garages: a private customer database, a reminder for every service, and an invoice for every visit.

sample.message: Hello Karim, your Toyota Corolla is due for an oil change at 10,500 km.

features.title: Everything a garage needs, nothing it doesn't
features.lead: Built to be fast for mechanics. If entering a service takes more than a few seconds, nobody uses it, so entry is the first thing we made quick.

quick.title: Quick entry in seconds
quick.text: Search by plate or phone, pick the service, confirm. The next change is worked out for you.

reminders.title: A reminder for every service
reminders.text: Oil, filters, brakes, battery and more. Each service has its own interval in km or months.

channels.title: Email and WhatsApp
channels.text: Reminders go out by email on their own, in the daytime. Or send one on WhatsApp in a tap.

invoices.title: An invoice for every visit
invoices.text: A clean PDF in Arabic or English, partial payments, and a list of who still owes you.

staff.title: Branches and staff
staff.text: Add branches and staff accounts, and give each role only what it needs.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: Only your garage sees your customers. Nothing can be exported, and every access is logged.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: From application to your first reminder in a few days.

apply.title: Apply
apply.text: Fill in the form below. We contact you and show you around.

account.title: We create your account
account.text: You get an email with a link to set your password.

customers.title: Add your customers
customers.text: Enter each customer and their cars, or add them as they come in.

reminders.title: Reminders run by themselves
reminders.text: Customers are reminded on time and come back. You see everything on your screen.

pricing.title: One price for every garage
pricing.details: Each extra branch {branch} a year. The first {days} days are free. Pay in cash or with Whish.
pricing.ask: Ask us for the price when we contact you.

app.q: Do my customers need an app?
app.a: No. They get their reminders by email or WhatsApp.

data.a: You do. Only your garage can see your customers, and nothing can be exported.

start.a: Apply below. Once approved, you get an email to set your password and can start adding customers.
